title: Preserving Heritage at the Alpaiwala Museum

photo.alt: Preserving Heritage at the Alpaiwala Museum

summary: The Urban Heritage Committee visited the Alpaiwala Museum, accompanied by Rtn. Arish Dastur and Rtn. Nandini Sampat.
description:
The Urban Heritage Committee visited the Alpaiwala Museum, accompanied by Rtn. Arish Dastur and Rtn. Nandini Sampat. A key highlight was
the entryway passage to the restoration laboratory, created from scratch by Rtn. Jamshed Banaji and Rtn. Ptn. Nirmala Banaji, reflecting their
contribution to preserving and showcasing our heritage.
